mostWorthwhile.text: Questioning the remembered song produced a different ending. It made inherited culture becoming new creation concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating teaching was a functional bridge, but its connection to changing the song was initially unclear.

surprise.text: A learner's new question became the means of changing a song, linking curiosity and tradition.

arbitrary.text: Shared discovery plus story felt somewhat disconnected from the song at first; the later question clarified its purpose. It was also the only available combination.

continue.text: Yes, I would be curious to see what the community creates next without my choosing its direction, though the mostly forced choices here limit the gameplay hook.
